title: Bart's funnies
description: adds some funny stuff, mostly useless for now. this mod exists for fun.
body:
currently contains 3 items two of which are creative only.
one item is a block of a thingy from a hatsune miku song
the other switches you between creative and survival.
the last is an unbreakable version of the first.
there is no other items so far.
will contain more.
